facts.fact: On 22 May 2026 Gabon's digital economy minister defended before the National Assembly finance committee the bill ratifying ordinance n°0002/PR/2026 of 29 January 2026 fixing the rules for digital payments nationwide, said to be aligned to the CEMAC payment-services regulation of 21 December 2018, with the committee's examination still to come and a plenary vote after.

BEAC Instruction n°002/GR/2026 of 5 May 2026 on pre-financing of inbound remittances through payment institutions supplements CEMAC Regulation n°04/18/CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC of 21 December 2018 on payment services in the CEMAC, with sanctions for breach, so binding rules on payment services apply across the CEMAC (the article names no country; Gabon is a CEMAC member).

facts.fact: The 2018 CEMAC payment-services regulation, as supplemented by BEAC Instruction n°002/GR/2026 of 5 May 2026, governs payment institutions (établissements de paiement) distinct from credit institutions, which the instruction obliges to report monthly to the central bank and subjects to penalties; the article names no country.

facts.fact: Citing COBAC's 2025 annual report, the article says seven licensed payment institutions operate in the CEMAC in 2025, and that Gabon's payment-institution sector, with Airtel Money Gabon and Clikpay Gabon present, earned FCFA 24.7 billion net banking income, down 13%.
